fieldValues.comment_text: Evidence from building the srs-web lenses proof of concept (2026-10-09, srs-programme:source-documents/srs-web-lenses-2026-10-09/assessment.md#engine-gaps). Six things had to be computed in the client because the core does not serve them: a whole Composition with its sections; per-record ids in rendered output (so a view cannot highlight the selection); relation usage counts per type; reading a note through the record binding; a type filter on neighbours; and a composition title. Each is a place where a second client would compute the same thing again. They belong as srs-rust issues answering SP-05 (and SP-24 for the first two).
